what.text: This page follows refugees from Iran living in Canada, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 13380 Iranian refugees in Canada, 8.5% of all refugees from Iran.
Germany and the United Kingdom host the most Iranian refugees, followed by Canada and Austria.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over the government of Iran in many years, most recently with Jaish al-Adl from 2023 to 2025.
It also records an interstate armed conflict between Iran and Israel from 2018 to 2025, and armed conflict over Kurdistan territory in Iran with the KDPI in 2016 and 2018.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 1994 at 10281 refugees, and the figure fell to a low in 2016.
It then rose again, and the main years of displacement in the data include 1994 to 1995, 2001 to 2003 and 2023 to 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Canada.
These are year-end totals for Canada only, reported to UNHCR.
